levels.title: NOT
levels.hint: Sometimes there is more than one kind of danger. Maybe we need a different way of thinking.

levels.title: Big Jump
hints: Spikes and pits are both "not ground".
Both dangers are two tiles wide.
Try: IF NOT Ground ahead, THEN Big Jump.

newItems.title: NEW ACTION: Big Jump
newItems.line: Jump clears one tile. Big Jump clears two tiles in a row.

newItems.title: NOT is now a button
newItems.line: Tap +NOT on a card to flip its condition. NOT Ground ahead is true before a pit and before a spike.

levels.title: Order
hints: At the pit, watch the pointer: which card does it stop at?
Move the Pit card to the front, so it is read first.
A normal Jump is too short for a two-tile pit: use Big Jump.

newItems.title: NEW RULE: card order
newItems.line: Cards are checked from left to right. The first card whose IF is true acts; the cards after it are not checked.

levels.title: Energy
levels.hint: One card for every danger costs too much Energy. Does every danger need a Big Jump?
hints: Watch the Energy bar: how much is left when you reach the pit?
The spike only needs a normal Jump (1 Energy).
Use the second slot: Spike -> Jump, in front of the Big Jump card.

newItems.title: NEW: Energy
newItems.line: Every jump costs Energy: Jump 1, Big Jump 3. A card without enough Energy does nothing - the runner just walks on.

levels.title: Breather
levels.hint: Nothing new here. Trust what you learned - a low wall isn't ground either.
hints: What worked last time?
A low wall is not ground.
IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: You've solved this before. One card was enough.
deathSpike: You've solved this before. One card was enough.
deathTimeout: Walls don't move. Something has to go over them.

newItems.title: NEW TILE: Low wall
newItems.line: A low wall blocks walking, but a jump clears it. It is not ground either.

levels.title: All Together
levels.hint: Everything from the tutorial, one course.
hints: You've seen every piece of this before.
Order matters as much as the cards.
Same two cards as the Order lesson (T4), in the same order.
deathPit: Some pits are wider than they look.
deathSpike: Check what each jump lands on.
levels.qiLine: Big Jumps are expensive. Save them for the wide gaps.

levels.title: Wait For It
levels.hint: Traps rise and fall. A Wait card costs 1 Energy and holds until the trap is down.
hints: Patience is cheaper than courage.
You can't jump here. You can only choose when to move.
IF Trap up ahead THEN Wait.
deathTrap: It stepped on it while it was up.
Timing isn't your job. Waiting is.
levels.qiLine: Not every trap needs a wait. Some are already down when you arrive.

newItems.title: NEW: Trap + Wait
newItems.line: Traps rise and fall. Wait costs 1 Energy and holds until the trap ahead is down.

levels.title: Turn Around
hints: Sometimes forward is the wrong way.
Walls are where you change your mind.
IF Wall ahead THEN Turn, then IF Pit ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: Turning around doesn't remove the pit.
deathTimeout: It's been walking into the same wall for a while now.
levels.qiLine: Turning and jumping both cost Energy. Do each only once.

newItems.title: NEW: Wall ahead + Turn
newItems.line: High walls and the course edge block everything. Turn faces the other way for 1 Energy.

levels.title: Stepping Stones
levels.hint: One tile of ground between every gap. Look where you will land before you leave.
hints: A jump lands two tiles ahead. Is that tile safe?
Ground 2 ahead looks exactly where a Jump would land.
IF NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, then IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: You checked the next tile. The landing was the one after it.
deathSpike: You checked the next tile. The landing was the one after it.
A short jump into a long gap.
levels.qiLine: Big Jumps are for double gaps only.
levels.previousLine: Nothing here to turn around from.

newItems.title: NEW CONDITION: Ground 2 ahead
newItems.line: Looks two tiles ahead - exactly where a Jump lands. NOT Ground 2 means a jump would land badly.

levels.title: Free Steps
levels.hint: Too little Energy to waste. A free Walk card can stop the costly cards after it - and orbs refill you.
hints: Safe ground deserves a free card.
A Walk card on the left stops every card to its right while the ground ahead is safe.
IF Ground ahead THEN Walk, then the two cards from 1-5.
deathPit: Your Big Jump left too early.
It jumped from solid ground into the gap.
deathSpike: Your Big Jump left too early.
levels.qiLine: You paid to cross ground you could have walked.
levels.previousLine: On long ground, Ground 2 ahead fires a step too early.

newItems.title: NEW ACTION: Walk
newItems.line: Free. Put it first: while the ground ahead is safe, the cards after it never fire.

newItems.title: NEW TILE: Energy orb
newItems.line: Walk or land on it for +2 Energy. The pool can go above its start.

levels.title: Everything You Know
levels.hint: Every tool so far, one course. The trap card has to come before the ground card.
hints: Traps count as ground.
Order: the most specific card first, the free Walk card right after it.
Trap -> Wait, Ground -> Walk, NOT Ground 2 -> Big Jump, NOT Ground -> Jump. In that order.
deathPit: Look two steps ahead before you leap.
deathSpike: Look two steps ahead before you leap.
deathTrap: The trap is ground too. Which card did it listen to first?
deathTimeout: It's waiting for a jump it can't afford.
levels.qiLine: You paid for jumps you didn't need.
levels.previousLine: Your 1-6 cards have never met a trap.

levels.title: AND
solution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Watch the Energy: it is gone before the last pit.
Tap + AND on card 1, then pick NOT Ground 2 ahead.
IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, then IF Pit ahead THEN Jump.

levels.title: Both Must Hold
levels.hint: Not every pit is the same width.
solution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
previousSolution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Only one gap is two pits wide. Everything else needs just a Jump.
IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead is true only right before the wide gap.
IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, then IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: Two pits in a row need a Big Jump. One pit needs only a Jump.
Check where each jump lands: a Big Jump goes one tile further.
Ground 2 ahead tells a wide gap from a narrow one.
deathSpike: A Big Jump lands one tile further than a Jump. Check what is there.
deathTimeout: Something is in the way, and no card jumps it.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. A Big Jump costs 3: save it for the wide gap.
levels.previousLine: Your guide cards only know pits. Something else is in the way here.

levels.title: Edge or Low Wall
solution: IF wall AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
previousSolution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Wall ahead is true at the edge AND at the low wall.
Ground 2 ahead tells them apart: there is nothing behind the edge.
IF Wall ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Turn, IF Pit ahead THEN Big Jump, IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: The gap was wider than the jump.
deathSpike: Something sharp was waiting where you landed.
deathTimeout: Wall ahead is true at the edge AND at the low wall.
Something is in the way, and no card gets past it.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Check which card fires at the edge, and which at the low wall.

newItems.title: HIGH WALL
newItems.line: The dark wall at each end of the map. Nothing can jump it. Wall ahead is true here too.

newItems.title: NEW CARD: TURN
newItems.line: Turn makes the runner face the other way. It costs 1 Energy.

levels.title: Two Checks
levels.hint: Two places need a closer look.
solution: IF spike AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
previousSolution: IF wall AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
hints: One spike is a dead end, and one gap is two pits wide.
Both can be found with NOT Ground 2 ahead: one with Spike ahead, one with Pit ahead.
IF Spike ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Turn, IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: Check where each jump lands: a Big Jump goes one tile further.
Two pits in a row need a Big Jump. One pit needs only a Jump.
That spike had a pit behind it.
deathSpike: Every other spike needs a Jump.
deathTimeout: Something is in the way, and no card gets past it.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Check which card fires at each spike and at each pit.
levels.previousLine: Your 2-2 cards only turn at walls. Here the dead end is a spike.
